title: generateStaticParams returning an empty array fails the build once cacheComponents is on
symptoms: A dynamic route that deferred all paths to runtime with return [] stops building
Removing generateStaticParams makes the build pass but the route renders on every request
cause: Under cacheComponents, Next.js needs at least one param to prerender and validate the route's static shell. The old pattern of returning [] to defer everything is now an error.
fix: Return at least one real param. Unlisted params are still rendered at request time. Keep the export, because deleting it opts the route out of ISR.
